item.title: Not Many People Like This Quiet

item.title: Where is Musa?
item.description: Nad-Ali rounded the bend of the alley—barefoot, bareheaded, gasping for breath. His face was drained of color. When he reached the crowd, he stopped, hands braced on his knees, breath trapped deep in his chest.
